call.content:
"""Usage: merge_csv.py FOLDER [--apply]  — merge every .csv in FOLDER into FOLDER/all.csv (dry run by default)."""
import csv, sys
from pathlib import Path

folder, apply = Path(sys.argv[1]), '--apply' in sys.argv
files = sorted(p for p in folder.glob('*.csv') if p.name != 'all.csv' and p.stat().st_size)
header, rows = None, []
for p in files:
    with p.open(newline='') as fh:
        r = list(csv.reader(fh))
    header = header or r[0]
    rows += r[1:]
print(f'{len(files)} files, {len(rows)} rows' + ('' if apply else ' (dry run)'))
if apply:
    with (folder / 'all.csv').open('w', newline='') as fh:
        csv.writer(fh).writerows([header] + rows)

call.command: cd "$PANTHEON_PROJECTS"/'scripts' && python3 merge_csv.py sample --dry-run && python3 merge_csv.py sample --apply && ls -R sample
